# T1 Plumbing & Heating Services Ltd

> Local, family-run plumbing and heating specialists based in Swadlincote, Derbyshire. We serve homes, landlords, and businesses across Derbyshire and Northwest Leicestershire with reliable, professional service — from dripping taps to full HMO conversions.

- **Phone:** 07886 157572 ([Call Now](tel:07886157572))

- **Address:** Swadlincote, Derbyshire, DE11 9PQ
- **Hours:** 24/7 emergency call-outs available

## Services

- **HMO Conversions** — Full plumbing & heating fit-outs for HMO landlords, compliant, on-time, and on-budget.
- **Bathroom Installations** — Bespoke bathroom installs from first fix to final tile, finished to a high standard.
- **General Plumbing** — Leaks, taps, toilets, kitchens — everyday plumbing done right, first time.
- **Heating & Boilers** — Boiler servicing, repairs, replacements, and central heating upgrades.
- **Emergency Call-Outs** — Burst pipes? No heating? Fast response across Derbyshire, 24/7.

## Coverage Area

Based in Swadlincote (DE11 9PQ), we work across South Derbyshire and surrounding Leicestershire villages and towns, including:
Swadlincote, Burton-upon-Trent, Ashby-de-la-Zouch, Derby, Castle Donington, Coalville, Melbourne, Repton, Woodville, Church Gresley, Measham, and Ticknall.
